title: Broad handlers swallow any exception with no record at any level (7 of 11 reached)
claim: Seven `except Exception` handlers the lifecycle reaches leave no log record at any level, DEBUG included, when their try body fails on every pass, so a programming error behind them is invisible: _record_accuracy's COP-residual tag, both _capture_diagnosis_inputs arms, CoordinatorDiagnostics.of, diagnostics._coordinator_snapshot and _never_breaks, and optimizer._lbfgsb_restart.
mechanism: Handler bodies are a bare fallback (`sample.cop_residual = None`, `return None`, `planned_wind = 0.0`, `'summary unavailable'`, `state = None`, `return 'unavailable'`, `return best`). The diagnostics three leave a visible marker in the downloaded diagnostics; the other four do not: a broken MeasuredCop.residual silently drops the COP tag from every accuracy sample, and a broken _current_weather silently records wind 0.0 as the plan's assumption in the diagnosis evidence (#52).

evidence.unit: broad handlers (of 11 reached non-logging, non-reraising broad handlers) adding zero records at any level under a persistent fault
evidence.machine: orchestrator Mac, Apple M1 (darwin arm64, 8 cores), shared box

instrumented_symbol: heatpump_optimizer.coordinator:HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator._record_accuracy (handler coordinator.py:10082) and the six sibling handlers, try bodies forced to raise by d1s3hook.py, driven through setup/refresh/diagnostics/unload/restart on a real asyncio loop

perturbation.change: coordinator.py:10083 `sample.cop_residual = None` -> `sample.cop_residual = _LOGGER.debug("COP residual tag skipped")` (still None; `--perturb`, in memory at import)

metric_definition: Reached broad handlers with no log call and no re-raise whose persistently raising try body added 0 integration log records at any level over the fault-free control.
phenomenon_property: No broad handler hides an exception: each one leaves at least a DEBUG record (or a held warning) naming what it swallowed.

proposed_fix_scope: A DEBUG record (exc_info) in each of the seven handlers; no behaviour change. coordinator.py, diagnostics.py, optimizer.py.
